name: Selenite
description: Genetically engineered from humans but considered a separate species, Selenites are long-limbed and lightly built for low-gravity environments. Most populations live on paraterraformed worlds in Alpha Crucis, particularly Velscur. Most Selenites working off-world are found in space industries.

traits.name: Great Indoors
traits.description: Selenites are deeply uncomfortable outside a controlled environment. When outdoors on a planet, whenever there is evidence of an uncontrolled environment (sudden rain, strong wind, etc.) a Selenite must make a Routine (6+) INT check or become disturbed — hunkering down in fear or making panicky demands for reassurance. Dangerous phenomena such as lightning or a hurricane require a harder check; failure may cause the Selenite to completely freak out.

traits.name: Low-G
traits.description: Selenites are naturally adept at operating in low gravity and microgravity environments. They receive DM+2 to all checks connected with physical activity in low-gravity conditions, such as moving quickly between handholds. A Selenite will not lose orientation when operating in a complex 3-dimensional space and can navigate derelict starships or debris fields without effort.

species_notes: STR rolled as 2D3+1 (range 3–7) and END rolled as 1D+1 (range 2–7) — both lower than the human average.
source: Traveller Aliens of Charted Space Volume 1, Mongoose Publishing
